overview.title: Overview
overview.hintNoInterface: No network adapter is selected. Without one, no streams are found.
overview.hintNoStreams: No announcements have arrived yet. This can take a few seconds.
overview.hintNoChannels: No channels have been set up yet. Operators see an empty page.

audio.title: Audio devices
audio.intro: This decides what the monitor plays out of.
audio.followSystem: Always use the system's default device
audio.followSystemHint: The monitor then follows the system output. A preferred device is ignored while this is on.
audio.reasonPinned: The preferred device is in use: {name}
audio.reasonFallback: The preferred device is not connected. Using {name} instead. It takes over again on its own as soon as it is reconnected.
audio.reasonDefault: No device chosen, the system default is in use: {name}
audio.preferHint: The preferred device is used whenever it is connected, including after a restart. While it is missing, playback continues on the fallback device.

channels.title: Channels
channels.empty: No channels have been set up yet.
channels.unsupportedFormat: Format not supported by the output device

admin.title: Set up channels
admin.intro: Operators see these channels, in this order.
admin.previewHint: This is what the operator view looks like. The order can be dragged here.
admin.name: Display name
admin.emptyHint: Take a stream as a channel on the Streams page.

streams.title: Streams
streams.emptyHint: It can take a few seconds for streams to appear.
streams.showUnsupported: Show streams that cannot be played
streams.wrongSampleRate: Sample rate not supported by the output device

senders.title: Senders
senders.intro: Devices announcing streams on the network.
senders.name: Name

stream.displayNameHint: This name appears in the operator view.
stream.mappingHint: Which channels of the stream go to the two outputs.

sdp.title: Add a stream
sdp.hint: Paste the stream's SDP data here.
sdp.announce: Announce the stream on the network via SAP
sdp.invalid: The SDP data could not be read.

appearance.themeHint: Dark is easier on the eyes in a darkened control room, light reads better in daylight.
appearance.perUser: This setting applies to this user only, not to the whole machine.

playback.deviceLink: The output device and the preferred device live under Audio devices.
playback.stabilityHint: More buffering survives trouble better but delays playback more.
playback.expertHint: Buffering in packets. For very short packet times the monitor raises this automatically.

network.interfaceHint: Streams are discovered and received over this adapter.
network.timeout: Hide streams that are no longer announced
network.timeoutHint: Devices announce themselves regularly. If an announcement stops, the stream counts as gone.

access.isSet: A password is set. Admin mode asks for it.
access.isNotSet: No password set. Admin mode opens without asking.
access.disclaimer: This lock guards against accidental operation. It is not access control: anyone who can edit the config file can bypass it.

errors.title: Notice
errors.workerRestarted: An internal service was restarted. Playback may have cut out briefly.
errors.configUnwritable: The settings could not be saved.
errors.noNetworkInterface: No network adapter available. No streams can be received.
